verdicts.statement: (Fadell and Neuwirth) If M is a manifold without boundary (not necessarily compact) and k ≥ m ≥ 1, then the projection map π_{k,m} from F(M,k) to F(M,m) is a fibration with fiber F(M − Q_m, k−m).
Let G be a torsion-free group and H a subgroup of finite index. Then the cohomological dimension of G equals the cohomological dimension of H, i.e. cd(G) = cd(H).

verdicts.statement: (P. Hall) If 1 → N → G → Q → 1 is a short exact sequence of groups with N and Q finitely presented, then G is finitely presented.
